items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: His brother was Jerry Byrd, a very good guitar player who recorded a lot and played with lots of people.

ctx.x: And then he always gave me little tips like when you’re done, when you’re done with the set, push the drawbars in. You don’t want people coming up and figuring out how you get those sounds you know. So yeah, you finished the set, boom, boom, boom, you pushed all the drawbars in. He was a riot this guy. His brother was Jerry Byrd, a very good guitar player who recorded a lot and played with lots of people.
You know you wouldn’t have a prayer now keeping that secret because people would just go behind you and they’d take out their phone and they’d take a picture of your drawbars.
